input.text: Fictional outpatient applications, eClaimLink-style claims, itemized bills, plan rules, history and provider statistics; Dubai

work.text: Enrollment eligibility; intake reconciliation; coding review; line coverage adjudication; fraud/waste/abuse review, each in multi-step tool loops

output.text: Recorded eligibility, bill mismatches, coding findings, line pay/deny with codes, and 0–1 fraud signals with pay/review/hold recommendation

criteria.text: Quality and reliable tool calling matter more than cost; rank best quality; existing Langfuse per-call, agent and claim evals

constraints.text: UAE processing required under stated residency interpretation; fictional data permits non-UAE endpoint only as recorded gap; Workers AI and OpenRouter used; human approves all payments

assumptions: Treat provider region as unknown until verified contractually; catalogue model routes alone do not establish UAE processing.
Use existing 14 claims and two enrollment fixtures as starting eval labels, not definitive ranking.

tasks.title: Claims intake
